item.title: Philippine Auto Industry Takes Tough Stance On Counterfeit Parts Sold Online
item.description: The Chamber of Automotive Manufacturers of the Philippines, Inc. (CAMPI) has officially signed the E-Commerce Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with leading e-commerce platforms, witnessed by the Intellectual Property Office of the Philippines (IPOPHL). This reinforces the organization’s commitment to protect consumers from counterfeit automotive products and promote vehicle safety standards across the country.Read More »

item.title: Nissan To Double NISMO Line-Up; Commits To Global Expansion
item.description: Nissan and Nissan Motorsports & Customization Co., Ltd. will be using its Nismo brand to enhance its own brand power as part of its Re:Nissan strategy. The Japanese carmaker will do this through new motorsports activities, more Nismo cars, and expanded restoration parts.Read More »

item.title: Honda To Remanufacture Original Parts For Sports Models
item.description: Honda is joining other Japanese carmakers in offering genuine replacement parts of classic sports models, offering owners and restorers of these prized cars a way to keep them on the road for much longer.Read More »

item.title: Ford Pivots From EVs to Hybrids, Extended Range EVs
item.description: Ford is following where customer demand is and is pivoting away from launching too many battery electric vehicles. Following the Mustang Mach-E and the F-150 Lightning, Ford will now launch a barrage of hybrids and extended range EVs by 2030.Read More »

item.title: BYD Is On Track To Beat Toyota's Dealer Count By End-2025

item.title: Specs, Colors, Prices: Everything You Need To Know About The 2026 Toyota GR Corolla
item.description: Who could have expected enthusiasts to be excited about, of all things, a Toyota Corolla. An iconic nameplate known more for being a no-nonsense commuter car just got a sprinkling of that Toyota Gazoo Racing magic, and in the process has turned the potential work (or school) run into something decidedly more exciting. Meet the first-ever GR Corolla and it’s now available for reservations at all Toyota GR Performance dealerships.Read More »
